messages.content: Return only the requested English text. Do not add a preface or word/token count.
Write a mixed first-person review of a fictional kitchen timer with a clear display, an annoying beep, and buttons difficult to press with wet hands. Aim for approximately 60–85 English tokens.

message.content: I'll give the ChefTick Pro credit where it's due: the big, bright display is easy to read from across the kitchen, even through steam. But that beep! It's shrill, relentless, and made my dog leave the room. Worse, the tiny buttons refuse to respond when my hands are wet, so I'm often jabbing at it while my pasta overcooks. I like seeing the countdown, yet I dread silencing it. Three stars, and only because of the screen.
